_doc: ⚑ S275 — THE POCKET PET (DESIGN_MISSING_YEARS_2026-10-31.md §6; his yes 31 Oct: 'keychain in the room and screen', 'show the resets'). Restorify's keychain companion, 2003: a virtual-pet reference (the 1996–2004 keychain pets: feed, play, clean, discipline; guilt; the morning check). OPERABLE: the programme's self-presentation, which may charm and must collapse. Its needs are the programme's duties (WORD, FELLOWSHIP, CONFESS; CORRECT is the coach's, greyed). The daily check-in feeds it; Lamby's face is the streak's mood and grows from the answers (no settings — 'Personalise your guide' is gone). It never mocks Daniel, never dies, has no timer and no sound. At Caleb's commit-press the streak breaks; after the intervention it goes still: 'no needs recorded'. Absent from felt scenes (it is a window on the programme's surface). Invented mark only. Text is Claude's under the 2026-08-17 norm; his edit wins.
title: Restorify Companion
